edition: Health news digest – Wednesday, 18 November 2026 – Morning edition

items.title: World COPD Day 2026 Focuses on Early Diagnosis and Management
items.summary: GOLD has set 'Early Diagnosis and Management for a Better Life' as the theme of World COPD Day on 18 November 2026, aimed at underdiagnosis and misdiagnosis of COPD. GOLD says activities are organized in more than 50 countries.

items.title: Connect Biopharma Reports Third Quarter 2026 Financial Results and Provides Business Update
items.summary: Connect Biopharma plans to meet the FDA in December 2026 to align on a Phase 3 program of rademikibart for acute asthma exacerbations, and in Q1 2027 for COPD. The plans follow positive preliminary Phase 2 Seabreeze STAT data reported in September 2026.

items.title: More Kids Face Insurance Denials For Asthma And Allergy Medications
items.summary: Researchers reviewed 326 biologic prescriptions written by allergists for children from 2018 to 2026. More than 90% required prior authorization from insurers. The study was presented at the ACAAI 2026 meeting in Phoenix.

items.title: FDA rejects ivonescimab for EGFR-mutated, locally advanced or metastatic NSCLC
items.summary: The FDA issued a complete response letter for Summit Therapeutics' ivonescimab plus chemotherapy in EGFR-mutated NSCLC after TKI therapy, citing no statistically significant overall survival improvement. In the HARMONi trial, median PFS was 6.8 vs 4.4 months (HR 0.52).

items.title: Lung cancer screening pilot in GAA clubs should help improve outcomes
items.summary: A commentary on an Irish pilot that brings lung cancer screening to community settings such as GAA clubs to reduce barriers to uptake. Ireland does not yet have a national lung cancer screening programme.
